hooks.command: : home-scan-guard; P='/Users/athos/gt/.gascity-gastown-hq/scripts/home-scan-guard.sh'; [ -f "$P" ] || exit 0; e=$(/bin/bash "$P" 2>&1 >/dev/null); r=$?; case "$r:$e" in 2:"home-scan-guard: BLOCKED"*) printf "%s\n" "$e" >&2; exit 2;; 0:*) exit 0;; esac; L="${HOME_SCAN_GUARD_LOG:-${HOME:-/tmp}/.gastown/logs/home-scan-guard.log}"; mkdir -p "${L%/*}" 2>/dev/null; printf "%s\tresult=UNGUARDED\treason=hook wrapper exited %s without a block verdict\n" "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$r" >> "$L" 2>/dev/null; exit 0
